name: Barbell Bench Press
equipmentItems: Rack with safety supports or a competent spotter
grip: Closed overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders, with the bar secure over the forearms.
description: Press a barbell above the chest while lying on a flat bench with the feet planted.
setup: Set rack hooks and safety supports for your body and range; use suitable spotting arrangements.
Lie with head, shoulders and hips supported and feet firmly on the floor.
Take a closed overhand grip and unrack the bar above the chest with the upper back stable.
instructions: Lower the bar under control toward the middle or lower chest.
Keep wrists above the forearms and elbows at a comfortable angle to the torso.
Press back above the chest and shoulders without lifting the hips.
Finish the set by guiding the bar securely into both rack hooks.
cues: Control the bar above the chest.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest or lowering toward the throat.
Lifting the hips or losing control of the bar while reracking.
